units.rawText: The Cyclopes Sector, at the former site of the quarantine wall – Gin's Bar.
units.displayText: The Cyclopes Sector, at the former site of the quarantine wall – Gin's Bar.

spans.text: The Cyclopes Sector, at the former site of the quarantine wall – Gin's Bar.

units.rawText: Why, you! Are you a barkeep or an electronic watchdog!?
units.displayText: Why, you! Are you a barkeep or an electronic watchdog!?

spans.text: Why, you! Are you a barkeep or an electronic watchdog!?

units.rawText: Gin answers Zangyin's anxiety with nothing more than a calm look.
units.displayText: Gin answers Zangyin's anxiety with nothing more than a calm look.

spans.text: Gin answers Zangyin's anxiety with nothing more than a calm look.

units.rawText: Meeting the needs of a customer is every bartender's duty. The Professor wishes for me to bring back every lost Doll we encounter as soon as possible.
units.displayText: Meeting the needs of a customer is every bartender's duty. The Professor wishes for me to bring back every lost Doll we encounter as soon as possible.

spans.text: Meeting the needs of a customer is every bartender's duty. The Professor wishes for me to bring back every lost Doll we encounter as soon as possible.

units.rawText: Also, the current Cyclopes Sector is not suitable for long-term habitation.
units.displayText: Also, the current Cyclopes Sector is not suitable for long-term habitation.

spans.text: Also, the current Cyclopes Sector is not suitable for long-term habitation.

units.rawText: You're not even listening to me, are you... Well then, by your own words, the fact that I'm here means that I'm a customer too.
units.displayText: You're not even listening to me, are you... Well then, by your own words, the fact that I'm here means that I'm a customer too.

spans.text: You're not even listening to me, are you... Well then, by your own words, the fact that I'm here means that I'm a customer too.

units.rawText: Of course.
units.displayText: Of course.

spans.text: Of course.

units.rawText: Fine then. I was squashed for too long and I'm starving.
units.displayText: Fine then. I was squashed for too long and I'm starving.

spans.text: Fine then. I was squashed for too long and I'm starving.

units.rawText: What would you like to eat?
units.displayText: What would you like to eat?

spans.text: What would you like to eat?

units.rawText: Meh, I don't want to give you a hard time, so some roast fish will do.
units.displayText: Meh, I don't want to give you a hard time, so some roast fish will do.

spans.text: Meh, I don't want to give you a hard time, so some roast fish will do.

units.rawText: That is not my area of specialty, Miss Zangyin.
units.displayText: That is not my area of specialty, Miss Zangyin.

spans.text: That is not my area of specialty, Miss Zangyin.

units.rawText: Didn't you say you wouldn't refuse a customer's request?
units.displayText: Didn't you say you wouldn't refuse a customer's request?

spans.text: Didn't you say you wouldn't refuse a customer's request?

units.rawText: I'm just saying that you might not be happy with the result.
units.displayText: I'm just saying that you might not be happy with the result.

spans.text: I'm just saying that you might not be happy with the result.

units.rawText: Zangyin sits at the counter and stretches.
units.displayText: Zangyin sits at the counter and stretches.

spans.text: Zangyin sits at the counter and stretches.

units.rawText: I understand. One moment, please.
units.displayText: I understand. One moment, please.

spans.text: I understand. One moment, please.

units.rawText: With that, Gin retreats into the bar's kitchen.
units.displayText: With that, Gin retreats into the bar's kitchen.

spans.text: With that, Gin retreats into the bar's kitchen.

units.rawText: (Was that asking too much of him?)
units.displayText: Was that asking too much of him?

spans.text: Was that asking too much of him?

units.rawText: (Eh, forget it, he must have some confidence in his skills since he agreed.)
units.displayText: Eh, forget it, he must have some confidence in his skills since he agreed.

spans.text: Eh, forget it, he must have some confidence in his skills since he agreed.

units.rawText: Zangyin listens to the faint sounds of a pressure cooker's valves and other mechanical noises coming from the kitchen and listlessly surveys her surroundings.
units.displayText: Zangyin listens to the faint sounds of a pressure cooker's valves and other mechanical noises coming from the kitchen and listlessly surveys her surroundings.

spans.text: Zangyin listens to the faint sounds of a pressure cooker's valves and other mechanical noises coming from the kitchen and listlessly surveys her surroundings.

units.rawText: (The shelf designs look like weapon racks. They must be the original furnishings from Cyclopes.)
units.displayText: The shelf designs look like weapon racks. They must be the original furnishings from Cyclopes.

spans.text: The shelf designs look like weapon racks. They must be the original furnishings from Cyclopes.

units.rawText: (Using military-style furniture for a bar is pretty in-theme with its location, but it doesn't look like anybody's visiting.)
units.displayText: Using military-style furniture for a bar is pretty in-theme with its location, but it doesn't look like anybody's visiting.

spans.text: Using military-style furniture for a bar is pretty in-theme with its location, but it doesn't look like anybody's visiting.

units.rawText: (When you get down to it, there's no way the bar would get any business if everyone in Cyclopes were like that Nameless.)
units.displayText: When you get down to it, there's no way the bar would get any business if everyone in Cyclopes were like that Nameless.

spans.text: When you get down to it, there's no way the bar would get any business if everyone in Cyclopes were like that Nameless.

units.rawText: Gentle piano music echoes through the bar. Zangyin continues looking around and finds herself starting to feel strangely sympathetic.
units.displayText: Gentle piano music echoes through the bar. Zangyin continues looking around and finds herself starting to feel strangely sympathetic.

spans.text: Gentle piano music echoes through the bar. Zangyin continues looking around and finds herself starting to feel strangely sympathetic.

units.rawText: Bullying a bartender who doesn't get any business is just sad. I should go check in on him.
units.displayText: Bullying a bartender who doesn't get any business is just sad. I should go check in on him.

spans.text: Bullying a bartender who doesn't get any business is just sad. I should go check in on him.

units.rawText: Zangyin stands up and circles over to the kitchen door, then knocks on it.
units.displayText: Zangyin stands up and circles over to the kitchen door, then knocks on it.

spans.text: Zangyin stands up and circles over to the kitchen door, then knocks on it.

units.rawText: Gin, are you alright in there?
units.displayText: Gin, are you alright in there?

spans.text: Gin, are you alright in there?

units.rawText: Sorry, Miss Zangyin, but I'll have to ask you to wait a little more.
units.displayText: Sorry, Miss Zangyin, but I'll have to ask you to wait a little more.

spans.text: Sorry, Miss Zangyin, but I'll have to ask you to wait a little more.

units.rawText: I think I smelled something burning in there. If you really can't make it then you don't need to force yourself to try.
units.displayText: I think I smelled something burning in there. If you really can't make it then you don't need to force yourself to try.

spans.text: I think I smelled something burning in there. If you really can't make it then you don't need to force yourself to try.

units.rawText: Alright. Please wait a little.
units.displayText: Alright. Please wait a little.

spans.text: Alright. Please wait a little.

units.rawText: What are you making in there that needs me to keep waiting? That's a pressure cooker, right? You should turn it off.
units.displayText: What are you making in there that needs me to keep waiting? That's a pressure cooker, right? You should turn it off.

spans.text: What are you making in there that needs me to keep waiting? That's a pressure cooker, right? You should turn it off.

units.rawText: Are you rushing to clean up because you burnt too many fish?
units.displayText: Are you rushing to clean up because you burnt too many fish?

spans.text: Are you rushing to clean up because you burnt too many fish?

units.rawText: Not at all.
units.displayText: Not at all.

spans.text: Not at all.

units.rawText: The truth is, I accidentally burnt my hand, so it's a little hard to move now.
units.displayText: The truth is, I accidentally burnt my hand, so it's a little hard to move now.

spans.text: The truth is, I accidentally burnt my hand, so it's a little hard to move now.

units.rawText: ...You don't need to push yourself THAT hard now, do you? Is it so hard to admit defeat?
units.displayText: ...You don't need to push yourself THAT hard now, do you? Is it so hard to admit defeat?

spans.text: ...You don't need to push yourself THAT hard now, do you? Is it so hard to admit defeat?

units.rawText: Zangyin places her ear to the door and tries to listen in on what's going on inside.
units.displayText: Zangyin places her ear to the door and tries to listen in on what's going on inside.

spans.text: Zangyin places her ear to the door and tries to listen in on what's going on inside.

units.rawText: The door trembles slightly, but the voice from behind it is still calm and steady.
units.displayText: The door trembles slightly, but the voice from behind it is still calm and steady.

spans.text: The door trembles slightly, but the voice from behind it is still calm and steady.

units.rawText: Drinks are things that make customers happy, and the same goes for bars.
units.displayText: Drinks are things that make customers happy, and the same goes for bars.

spans.text: Drinks are things that make customers happy, and the same goes for bars.

units.rawText: Do you seriously not know the difference between teasing and an actual request...
units.displayText: Do you seriously not know the difference between teasing and an actual request...

spans.text: Do you seriously not know the difference between teasing and an actual request...

units.rawText: If you're making fun of me, then you must surely wish to be happy, Miss Zangyin.
units.displayText: If you're making fun of me, then you must surely wish to be happy, Miss Zangyin.

spans.text: If you're making fun of me, then you must surely wish to be happy, Miss Zangyin.

units.rawText: To you, that would be like a spiritual cocktail.
units.displayText: To you, that would be like a spiritual cocktail.

spans.text: To you, that would be like a spiritual cocktail.

units.rawText: I guess that works. Are you done cleaning up inside?
units.displayText: I guess that works. Are you done cleaning up inside?

spans.text: I guess that works. Are you done cleaning up inside?

units.rawText: I'm sorry, but not yet.
units.displayText: I'm sorry, but not yet.

spans.text: I'm sorry, but not yet.

units.rawText: The door's vibrations seem to grow a little more intense.
units.displayText: The door's vibrations seem to grow a little more intense.

spans.text: The door's vibrations seem to grow a little more intense.

units.rawText: Was that an earthquake? It doesn't seem quite right...
units.displayText: Was that an earthquake? It doesn't seem quite right...

spans.text: Was that an earthquake? It doesn't seem quite right...

units.rawText: Perhaps it is because there is no way to shut off the pressure cooker.
units.displayText: Perhaps it is because there is no way to shut off the pressure cooker.

spans.text: Perhaps it is because there is no way to shut off the pressure cooker.

units.rawText: Zangyin doesn't bother sparing a thought for etiquette and immediately opens the door.
units.displayText: Zangyin doesn't bother sparing a thought for etiquette and immediately opens the door.

spans.text: Zangyin doesn't bother sparing a thought for etiquette and immediately opens the door.

units.rawText: The acrid stench of burning fills her nose, and she sees Gin with a burnt hand on the old-style pressure cooker's valve, whose gauge needle is well into the red zone—
units.displayText: The acrid stench of burning fills her nose, and she sees Gin with a burnt hand on the old-style pressure cooker's valve, whose gauge needle is well into the red zone—

spans.text: The acrid stench of burning fills her nose, and she sees Gin with a burnt hand on the old-style pressure cooker's valve, whose gauge needle is well into the red zone—

units.rawText: What are you doing? It's about to explode!
units.displayText: What are you doing? It's about to explode!

spans.text: What are you doing? It's about to explode!

units.rawText: I was trying to turn it off, but the valve doesn't seem to be engaged. Perhaps its design is too old.
units.displayText: I was trying to turn it off, but the valve doesn't seem to be engaged. Perhaps its design is too old.

spans.text: I was trying to turn it off, but the valve doesn't seem to be engaged. Perhaps its design is too old.

units.rawText: <size=36>Isn't this an accident!?</size>
units.displayText: Isn't this an accident!?

spans.text: Isn't this an accident!?

units.rawText: Yes.
units.displayText: Yes.

spans.text: Yes.

units.rawText: How can you stay so calm at a time like this? <size=40>RUN!</size>
units.displayText: How can you stay so calm at a time like this? RUN!

spans.text: How can you stay so calm at a time like this?
RUN!

units.rawText: Zangyin doesn't spare a second thought before she grabs Gin by the sleeve and runs out of the bar, dragging him behind her.
units.displayText: Zangyin doesn't spare a second thought before she grabs Gin by the sleeve and runs out of the bar, dragging him behind her.

spans.text: Zangyin doesn't spare a second thought before she grabs Gin by the sleeve and runs out of the bar, dragging him behind her.

units.rawText: Just as they reach the main room and are about to leave the bar—
units.displayText: Just as they reach the main room and are about to leave the bar—

spans.text: Just as they reach the main room and are about to leave the bar—

units.rawText: <size=60>KABOOM!</size>
units.displayText: KABOOM!

spans.text: KABOOM!

units.rawText: The bar promptly collapses amidst a massive explosion, burying the two Dolls.
units.displayText: The bar promptly collapses amidst a massive explosion, burying the two Dolls.

spans.text: The bar promptly collapses amidst a massive explosion, burying the two Dolls.
